title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam delay reveals a troubling pattern behind its biggest network upgrades
summary: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade has slipped into 2027, exposing a growing disconnect between faster development and the network's ability to meet deadlines. On Nov. 20, Ethereum Foundation researcher Toni Wahrstätter said the upgrade, which the foundation had targeted for the first half of 2026, cannot reach mainnet before mid-January 2027, after delays disrupted its testing schedule.… Read the full story on CryptoSlate Understand the crypto stories that matter and what to watch next.
